critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: when ManualOrderDialog mounts, Emergent's instrumentation wraps native <option> children in <span>, triggering a React hydration dev warning (`<option> cannot be a child of <span>`). It is harmless at runtime but pollutes the console — consider moving the option label into a non-text child or filing it against the instrumentation layer.
